items.name: 三國幻想錄:開局送5星關羽
items.description:
黃巾亂起，朝野動盪，大漢江山分崩離析。天下豪雄趁勢而起，諸侯割據四方，戰火蔓延城郭鄉野。梟雄懷吞併天下之志，義士抱匡扶社稷之心，無數武將謀臣登場，譜寫一段段可歌可泣的亂世傳奇。在這風雲變幻的時代，你將作為一方勢力的掌權者，招攬四海豪傑，籌劃軍策，征戰四方，書寫屬於你的三國霸業。

離線掛機躺收資源，告別爆肝刷本；抽中新武將即可直接上陣，無需耗費資源重複培養。打破品質束縛，所有武將皆可突破至無雙境界，無論蓋世名將，或是冷門文臣武吏，只要是你心儀的角色，都能成為隊伍核心主 C。

【幻想亂世・群賢匯聚】
百餘位三國武將經過全新美術演繹，魏、蜀、吳、羣四方豪傑盡數登場。於酒館邂逅各路名將，解鎖武將專屬傳記，窺見英雄背後不為人知的故事，沉浸式感受波瀾壯闊的漢末風雲。

【離線放置，輕鬆征伐天下】
主線闖關全自動戰鬥，離線掛機持續產出金幣、裝備、各類養成素材。上線一鍵領取全部累積收益，利用碎片化時間就能實力進階。閒暇之餘掛機養成，空閒時間調整隊伍陣容，無需耗費大量時間反覆刷關。

【策略佈陣，自由搭配陣容】
不局限傳統強力國家隊，高自由度陣容隨意組合。武將羈絆連攜、神兵秘寶、戰魂加持、站位博弈，不存在一套通吃全關卡的萬能隊伍。依據敵方陣容靈活調整武將，無損切換隊員，巧謀克敵，以智謀決勝沙場。

【多元玩法，飽覽三國風華】
闖關試煉、秘境探險、跨服演武、群雄擂台、軍團混戰等豐富內容。PVE 闖

items.name: Flag QWZ: World Geography Quiz
items.description:
Flag QWZ is a world geography quiz that turns flag recognition into a quick game. Every round shows you ten flags with three answers each — how many countries do you actually know?

You start with thirty countries in Level 1. As your eye sharpens, unlock country packs and grow the game all the way to 250 nations across the Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa and Oceania.

A flag appears. You pick the country. Get it right and your score climbs; get it wrong and you walk away knowing a flag you didn't before. Rounds are short on purpose — one fits in a coffee break, ten fit in a commut

items.name: Goods Joy - Food Stock Clear
items.description:
Outside, the snow glints cold; inside a wooden cabin two squirrels are busy stashing food into the pantry. Come fill the shelves and leave a whole winter’s worth of warmth.

— Warm visuals: hand-drawn squirrels and cabin scenes make every frame feel like a postcard.
— Easy taps: tap items in the pantry—three matching items pair up and are stored away automatically, making the tidy-up simple and rhythmic.
— Collecting satisfaction: watch the cupboards slowly fill and the shelves stack up winter supplies; a quiet sense of being cared for will gently rise.
— Perfect for short sessions: quick tidy

items.name: Orlan – Card Game
items.description:
Orlan is a traditional Aramaic card game. Its name comes from the Aramaic word for the jack, the most powerful card in the game.

The idea is simple: play a card to capture cards from the table, and score points at the end of each round. A number card captures the cards that add up to 11 with it, a queen takes a queen, a king takes a king, and the jack sweeps up every number card and jack on the table. The 2 of clubs, the 10 of diamonds, the clubs and the biggest pile all score. The first player or team to reach 21 points wins.

• 2 to 4 players, alone or in teams of two
• Play against the AI,

items.name: Dragoncoil: Snake Dungeon
items.description:
Dragoncoil: Snake Dungeon is a swipe-based snake roguelike dungeon game. Guide elemental dragons through grid-based labyrinths, consume dragon hearts, and grow your coil as you descend.

Choose the dragon that fits your style. The Fire Dragon grows through kills and can gain a flame guard. The Ice Dragon freezes foes and raises ice walls. The Volt Dragon shocks and slows enemies. The Earth Dragon stores armor, blocks hits, and breaks walls. The Ghost Dragon stores phase energy to pass through inner walls.

Every expedition is a route-planning challenge through walls, traps, and hostile creatur

items.name: GAP by Kridona
items.description:
Walls rush at you. Each one has a hole: tall, wide or square. Swipe to become the shape in time and slip through.

• 60 levels, each one harder than the last
• New tricks keep coming: double walls, ghost walls that appear late, holes that change at the last moment, spinning walls, lights out and speed surges
• Every level is tested by a robot with human reaction time. Hard, never impossible
• Short runs, one thumb, made for the bus and the queue
• No ads, no account, works offline

The first 15 levels are free. One purchase unlocks all 60, for good.

items.name: ABC Trace: Learn to Write
items.description:
Welcome to ABC Trace — a magical handwriting adventure designed to make learning to write letters, numbers, and words exciting, playful, and rewarding for young learners!
Guided by Tiki, our friendly learning mascot, children journey across vibrant worlds, developing fine motor skills and letter recognition stroke by stroke.
WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN & EXPLORE:
• CAPITAL & LOWERCASE LETTERS:
Step-by-step guided stroke tracing for all 26 letters (A–Z and a–z). Visual guidelines and sparkle trails teach proper letter formation from start to finish.
• NUMBER JUNGLE (1–20):
Trace numbers with ani

items.name: Ada Tanrısı: Island God
items.description:
Ada Tanrısı (Island God) is a calm but deep god simulation set on a small island of hexagonal tiles. Villagers live their own lives: they farm, fish, chop wood, quarry stone, hunt, marry, raise children and grow old. You never command them directly. Instead you shape the land, plant forests, and send rain, blessings and healing. In your wrath you call down lightning, storms, earthquakes, meteors and volcanoes.

GRACE AND WRATH
• Every miracle shows its area and outcome before you cast it
• Drought, fire, plague, locusts, storms, earthquakes, volcanoes and tsunamis — disasters warn you first, t

items.name: AirParcel: Letters by Air
items.description:
AirParcel is mail that has to fly.

You write to someone, you choose an aircraft, and it leaves your airport for theirs. Then you wait. A prop from London to Paris is a short hop. The same prop to Sydney is most of a day. Nothing arrives instantly, because nothing that actually crosses an ocean arrives instantly.

That waiting is the whole point. A message you cannot take back for six hours is a message you write differently.

WHAT YOU SEND
Letters. Photographs. Voice notes. Documents. All of it goes in the hold, all of it lands together, and none of it is readable until the aircraft is down a

items.name: Al-Wayet
items.description:
The water truck has arrived, and the whole neighbourhood is waiting!

Your job sounds simple: share the truck's water between the rooftop tanks. But every tank has a capacity, every pipe has a speed, and water waits for no one. Open a valve too late and the tank overflows; open it too early and another house goes dry.

• 20 levels, from an easy start to puzzles that make you think
• Real water physics: upper floors fill slower, shared pipes split the pressure
• Stuck valves, diverters, float valves, and a corner shop that gets priority
• A daytime and a night-time neighbourhood with their own

items.name: Angel Warrior
items.description:
One tap. One sword. One angel against the dark.

Fly down through six realms of the abyss: fire, ash, brimstone, the hive, the drowned swamp, and the frozen pit. Every tap lifts your wings. Every pass of your blade can cut a demon from the sky.

Rescue the kneeling souls to mend your strength and raise your score. Slip through columns of stone, rust, honey, rotten wood and ice, some of them shifting as you fly.

At the bottom waits the Final Demon, a beast made of everything you've fought. Defeat it and set the captive souls free.

• Simple one-tap controls, hard to master
• Six painterly real

items.name: AnyGame
items.description:
Describe any two-player game in a sentence, and Anygame builds it so you can play it with a friend, turn by turn, right inside iMessage.

Want four in a row where gravity flips every third turn? A word duel where whoever completes a real word loses? Type it in, and usually a minute or two later it’s a game you can play in your chat. Or start with a quick round of Tic-Tac-Toe.

How it works
1. In an iMessage conversation, tap + and choose Anygame. If you don’t see it, swipe up to see more apps.
2. Tap “Make a new game” and describe your game in your own words, or pick Tic-Tac-Toe under Classics

items.name: Apex Fish
items.description:
Eat. Grow. Evolve.
Apex Fish is a 3D action game where you swallow your way from a tiny river fish to the apex of the ocean, with every creature at its real size.

445 REAL-SIZE CREATURES
Medaka, ayu, sturgeon, great white shark, orca, blue whale… Every species appears at its real length, so you always know how big you are: "1.2× Shiba Inu", "2.4× 25 m pool".

BECOME WHAT YOU EAT
Evolve into anything you've eaten or taken down with a Giant Kill. Outrun danger as a mako? Hunt big game with a great white's bite? Or build a chimera with a different head, body and tail.

EAT OR BE EATEN
When a big

items.name: Aquamarine: Fish and Tank
items.description:
Dive into Aquamarine, a cozy fishing and aquarium-keeping game where every catch finds a home.

CAST & REEL
Time your cast, track the bite, and reel it in with skill. Every catch is scored for bite reaction, tracking accuracy, and struggle control, with grades from S to D. Land a rare species and you might just get a Shiny surprise.

THREE LIVING BIOMES
Explore Freshwater, Reef, and Deep Sea, each with its own cast of fish species across six rarity tiers, from Common to Mythic. Unlock new biomes as you progress.

Watch your catches swim, feed them, keep their tank clean, and

items.name: Arcadian: TowerDefense
items.description:
Build your castle, raise your walls, stop the horde!

In Arcadian: TowerDefense you lead your hero, collect gold and raise towers around your castle. The enemy comes in waves: runners, armored brutes, splitting swarms and giant bosses… Don't let the gates fall!

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO PUT DOWN
• One-finger play: walk with the joystick, collect gold, build towers.
• Train soldiers at the barracks and station them in your towers.
• Every tower you build pushes your walls forward: as your land grows, your castle grows stronger.

items.name: Ye or Nay: Did Ye Say It?
items.description:
Did Ye really say it?

Ye or Nay is a fast, simple game: you see a quote, you guess. Ye if you think he really said it. Nay if you think it's fake.

Some quotes are real, pulled from tweets and interviews spanning two decades. Others were written to sound exactly like him. Telling them apart is harder than you think.

• Every real quote is cited: see the tweet or the interview it came from, with a link to the source
• Fakes get stamped FAKE, so you always know what's real
• Classic: 20 quotes per round, beat your high score

items.name: Hold the Keep
items.description:
Raiders are coming. Hold the Keep!

Drag back the catapult and let fly: boulders that send raiders tumbling, fire pots that burn whole packs, and nets that catch enemies alive so you can recruit them to your towers.

FIVE DEADLY REALMS
• Meadow Keep: horned raiders with shields and siege ladders
• Frostpeak Pass: ice wolves, frost trolls and snowball-hurling yetis in the blizzard
• Sunken Marsh: the dead rise again unless you burn them
• Emberfall: fireproof golems and flying imps over a river of lava
• Dune Fortress: tomb guards and giant scorpions strike the whole wall at once

A NEW STRATEG

items.name: Puffy Closet Spatial
items.description:
Step into Puffy's room on Apple Vision Pro!

A cozy pastel kids' room appears all around you, full of fluffy plush friends: Teddy the bear, Bunbun the bunny, Mochi the cat, Pandy the panda, Ribbit the frog, Puffy the puffling, Rexy the dinosaur, Coco the parrot, Hamham the hamster and Fifi the flamingo. Pick a puff from the bookshelf and it hops onto the rug in front of you.

A REAL 3D CLOSET
• Open the doors of a big pink closet and look inside
• Hats hang on the inside of the doors, outfits on hangers, glasses, necklaces and a shoe rack on the shelves
• Tap an item and your puff wears it in

items.name: MrDuo
items.description:
Grabe dir deinen Weg zum Highscore! In MrDuo sammelst du Kirschen, weichst Gegnern aus und setzt deinen Ball im richtigen Moment ein. Herabfallende Äpfel können dir den Weg freimachen – Timing und geschickte Wege entscheiden über die nächste Runde.

Steuere deine Spielfigur mit dem schwebenden Vierwege-Joystick und wirf den Ball über die FEUER-Taste. Bewegung und Feuer lassen sich gleichzeitig bedienen. Alternativ spielst du mit einem kompatiblen Gamepad.

items.name: Air Combat - Board Game
items.description:
Air Combat is a turn-based strategy game for two players, a remake of a classic board game.

Two air forces face each other across a board of sea and islands. Each side has 6 bombers, 10 fighters, 8 anti-aircraft guns, 4 missile batteries and a headquarters. Take off from your airfield, steer around the enemy guns and outmanoeuvre the enemy fighters.

HOW TO WIN
• Fly a bomber over the enemy headquarters, or
• Shoot down all six enemy bombers and at least eight of the ten fighters.

items.name: Angry Yiayia
items.description:
Don’t make Yiayia angry!

Slide your tray to save falling plates in a Greek arcade adventure. Travel through ten themed levels, from a sunny courtyard and mountain cherry festival to a wedding, island ferry, and the Acropolis. Each stage gets faster, with more plates to save and less room for mistakes.

Catch special items to turn the chaos in your favor:
• Greek flag plates award bonus points.
• Evil-eye plates restore a life or award a big score bonus.
• Shark vases double your tray and points for five seconds.
• Gyro plates protect you from Zeus’s lightning at the Acropolis.

Yiayia and Pap

items.name: Bungeoppang in the Town
items.description:
Bungeoppang in the Town is a pixel-art shop game about running a tiny street stall that sells bungeoppang, the warm fish-shaped bread Koreans love in winter.

Buy fillings, set a price for each flavor and tap Start selling to open for one minute. Tap an empty mold to pour the batter, tap again to flip it once the bottom is cooked, and tap to take it out when both sides are golden. Serve each customer in line the flavor they asked for. Keep them waiting too long and they leave angry.

• One tap to pour, flip and take out
• Six flavors: red bean, custard, sweet potato, cheese, pizza and choco

items.description:
Cheddar Chase is a block-pushing puzzle game about one clever mouse and a house full of cats. Push blocks to box in every cat, and each trapped cat turns into cheese. Eat the cheese, win the level.

It plays fully offline. There are no ads, no in-app purchases and no accounts.

HOW IT PLAYS
Swipe to run, hold to keep going. Think ahead: blocks only slide one way, and a cat that gets out will come for you. Made a mess of it? Undo your moves or restart the level.

• Packs: 32 handcrafted levels in four places, from the Basement and Kitchen to the Attic and Master. Earn up to three s

items.name: Chromatic Convergence
items.description:
Tap an orb and every orb of its colour flies to it. Simple, until the paths cross: if two different colours touch, it's over.

Chromatic Convergence is a calm-looking, fiercely clever colour puzzle. Frosted glass orbs, glowing trails of light and soft explosions turn every solution into a small firework.

100 PUZZLES
• From three gentle tutorials to fiendish boards of up to 20 orbs
• Read the paths, pick the right target, find the right order
• The last 25 puzzles demand timing: launch a colour while another is still moving

items.name: Cosmic Kebab!
items.description:
Explore the galaxy. Slay monsters. Serve dinner!

The universe is full of strange creatures. Some are dangerous, some are disgusting, and some are surprisingly delicious!

In Cosmic Kebab!, travel through portals to hunt monsters on bizarre alien planets, turn your freshly acquired ingredients into delicious meals, and serve them to unsuspecting customers. After all, if the customers are happy, who cares which planet their dinner came from?

We have vegetarian options, too! Just don't ask what's in them.

items.name: Dam Nation
items.description:
The Beaver Dominion has approved a modest public infrastructure project on the eastern tributary. The squirrels have filed a petition. The raccoons have filed an invoice. The geese have filed in, honking.

Dam Nation is a real-time strategy game about one river and four nations who all want it. Build a settlement, gather timber and food, raise an army, and then do what beavers do best: build a dam. The water is real. It rises behind your dam, backs up across the valley and pours over anyone who built in the wrong place.

items.name: Darcnia Walker: Monster RPG
items.description:
Darcnia Walker is a monster-collecting RPG and walking game built for Apple Watch. Every real step you take becomes exploration chances, eggs that hatch and creatures that grow. Play right on your wrist, no phone needed.

WALKING GAME POWERED BY YOUR STEP COUNTER
Your watch's step counter (HealthKit) drives the adventure: walk to find wild creatures, hatch eggs, heal your team and earn coins. No faked steps, the game only counts what your watch records.

items.name: Diamantenwelt
items.description:
Stack sparkling gem stones, clear rows and relax in a bright pastel crystal world – no ads, no distractions, no extra costs.

Diamantenwelt is the classic falling-blocks puzzle with a playful pastel look. You know the rules instantly: rotate the stones, drop them in place, complete rows. And then you just want to play one more level.

SPARKLING GEMS YOUR WAY
Play with colourful stones or in a single gem colour – choose from 10 shades. Pick classic squares or elegantly cut diamond shapes.

ENDLESS LEVELS
The levels never run out. Stones fall a little faster each time – gentle enough for a relax

items.name: Drapers: Medieval Trade Empire
items.description:
It is 1242 AD, and cloth is worth more than crowns. 

Begin your journey as a novice cloth merchant in the dangerous, high-stakes waters of the medieval Mediterranean. Your goal? Out-maneuver up to seven rival merchant cities to build the wealthiest trade empire of the old world. Inspired by classic modern Euro-style board games, Drapers: Merchants of Middle Ages combines deep tactical optimization with lightning-fast, high-interaction gameplay.

Fast-Paced Strategy Game: A complete, deep economic trade war played out in under 30 minutes. 

Eurogame Mechanics: Build tight product

items.name: Dungeon God: Ascension
items.description:
Descend into the dungeon. Rise as a god.

Dungeon God: Ascension is a top-down pixel-art action roguelite. Take up your sword, fight your way through dark stone halls full of skeletons, slimes and bats, and reach the golden light of the ancient archway.

FAST, SATISFYING COMBAT
Simple touch controls built for mobile: move with the joystick, attack with a tap. Dodge, slash and survive waves of monsters in quick, intense fights.

EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT
Dungeon rooms, enemies and rewards change every time you play. Learn, adapt and push a little deeper on each attempt.

GROW STRONGER
Collect gold

items.name: Ember Reborn
items.description:
A ruined world. A flame that refuses to die.

Awaken as a silver-haired swordsman in EMBER REBORN, a mobile dark sci-fi side-scrolling action roguelite. Explore machine-ruled ruins, collect EMBER, and build the strength to face the truth beyond the ashes.

FAST, PRECISE SWORDPLAY
Chain four-hit sword attacks, dash through danger, jump into aerial combat, and parry to create openings. Enhance your finishing strike and unlock fire and lightning attacks.

10 SKILLS. TWO SLOTS. YOUR RUN.

items.name: Fairway Duo
items.description:
Fold it. Roll it. Drive it 300 yards.

Fairway Duo turns your iPhone Duo into a pocket arcade golf cabinet. Fold the phone half-way and stand it up: the top half becomes the monitor, and the bottom half becomes a control panel with a glowing trackball and arcade buttons.

• Roll the trackball back, then fire it forward. The harder you push, the farther it flies.

items.name: Finnegan's Flip-Flop
items.description:
Finnegan is a rainbow fish with big dreams and a small tank. When his best friend Leo wishes for a pet he can hug, Finnegan and the bedroom toys hatch a plan.

• Swim, flip and gobble fish flakes in the tank
• Pick toy tools to crack the glass. KER-SPLASH!
• Flop across the floor while a rubber duck keeps you wet
• Get zapped into a kitten by Professor Twinkle
• Parkour around the bedroom: run, jump, flip and knock things off shelves
• Spell your name and blow bubbles to prove you're really Finnegan

items.name: Flickleball
items.description:
Pickleball, the way it feels: drag to move, flick to hit.

Flickleball is a retro pixel sports game built around one simple control. Run into position with your thumb, then flick — a quick, firm flick drives, a short, soft one drops into the kitchen, a pause and a sharp flick lobs over the net player. Curve the end of the flick to add spin.

items.name: Focus Pull: Keep It Sharp
items.description:
You're the focus puller on a night shoot. The actor walks toward the camera, stops, turns and walks away. Your thumb is on the lens. Keep her sharp.

Focus Pull is a calm, absorbing skill game about the most precise job on a film set. Drag the focus ring and watch the picture snap from soft to razor sharp. The bokeh lights in the background bloom and shrink as you move.

items.name: FoldToBreak

Close your phone on something breakable and hear it shatter.

Fold to Break is a breaking toy built for iPhone Duo. Something breakable sits across the fold. Close your phone on it and it cracks right along the hinge. Open it, push the pieces back onto the fold and close it again, until it's dust.

items.name: Galaxy Zappers
items.description:
Galaxy Zappers is a bright, friendly space shooter the whole family can play — no ads, no in-app purchases, no internet needed.

Steer your ship, hold the fire button and zap waves of wiggly aliens. Watch out: when an alien flashes red, it's about to dive at you! Fly over floating astronauts to rescue them (just don't zap them), grab power-ups, and catch stars, gems and hearts on bonus stages.

items.name: Gold Rush Racer 2026
items.description:
Altın kamyonu kaçıyor ve kasasından yola altın saçıyor! Direksiyona geç, dökülen altınları topla, bombalardan ve çukurlardan kaç, yakıtın bitmeden olabildiğince uzağa git.

items.name: Isles of Memory
items.description:
The islands have lost their memories. Find the fragments they left behind.

Arrive unarmed in a mist-covered archipelago. A few villagers still remember the past. Listen to their stories, find your first equipment and set out along forgotten paths.

EXPLORE THE ARCHIPELAGO
Cross bridges between islands, from villages and forests to marshes, deserts and snowy lands. Consult your map of visited places and follow the villagers’ clues.

CHALLENGE THE SANCTUARIES
Explore nine dungeons, solve their puzzles and face their guardians. Collect keys, uncover treasures and earn new equipment to progress.

items.name: Istanbul Tycoon
items.description:
You have just arrived in Kadıköy, Istanbul's liveliest neighbourhood, with a little money and big dreams. Old Kemal Dayı shows you the first steps: rent a flat, work the till at the corner market, open your first shop and build a business empire of your own.

BUILD YOUR SHOPS
• Coffee shop, bakery, döner stand, dessert shop, florist, bookshop, market, barber, clothing store, record shop and more
• Place the furniture yourself, fill the shelves with boxes from the wholesaler, set your prices
• Work the till or hire staff; manage shifts, wages and your team's happiness

items.name: Last Drop: Pour Perfect

Hold to pour. Let go. Did you hit the line?

Last Drop is a calm, very satisfying skill game about pouring the perfect drink. Every liquid behaves differently: water stops on a dime, syrup keeps flowing after you let go, and soda foams up before it settles. Glasses have real shapes, so a cone fills fast at the bottom and slow at the top.
